answer_quote: This image shows a surgical specimen consisting of large, matted masses of tissue. This appearance is consistent with massive lymph node enlargement (lymphadenopathy), where multiple enlarged nodes have grown together to form a conglomerate mass.
note: 回答称多团块外观与融合性大量淋巴结肿大相符，同时指出无法仅凭照片诊断淋巴瘤；可见多叶融合组织，但具体组织性质需病理确认。
